b: Wired2fish is proud to partner with onX to give five lucky anglers each a one-year subscription to the onX Fish app. Here’s a chance to win yours now!

The suite of onX products are built by adventurers, for adventurers. It designs its navigation apps with the belief that every adventurer needs to know where to go, to know where they stand, and to be able to share their experiences.

onX Fish is onX’s fishing app. It helps anglers discover new waters, understand fisheries, and plan their next trip with confidence. You can search lakes by species, trophy potential, and fish abundance. Then, you can explore detailed maps, public access points, weather forecasts, and insights from local experts. With offline maps and customizable waypoints, onX Fish brings scouting, planning, and navigation together all in one app.

Currently, onX Fish Midwest is available in the following states: Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, and Wisconsin. The app will be adding more states in the future.

The onX Fish giveaway dates run from Nov. 23 to Dec. 7. Five winners will be selected at random from all eligible entries. Each will receive a one-year subscription to onX Fish; if onX Fish is not currently available in a winner’s area, their subscription will start when their region receives service.
